items.question: ¿Dónde obtengo Buddy Web?
items.answer: Empieza en aipify.ai — crea una cuenta gratis con Empezar gratis, luego conecta y activa Buddy Web en tu sitio.

items.question: ¿Cómo lo instalo?
items.answer: Cuando el espacio de trabajo esté listo, sigue la conexión e instalación guiadas en Aipify. Tú decides cuándo el asistente se publica.

items.question: ¿De dónde saca las respuestas Buddy?
items.answer: Buddy usa el contenido publicado y el conocimiento que apruebas — no conjeturas abiertas de toda la web.

items.question: ¿Qué idiomas se admiten?
items.answer: El marketing público y el producto de Aipify admiten noruego, sueco, danés, inglés, español, polaco y ucraniano. El asistente del visitante sigue los idiomas configurados para tu sitio.

items.question: ¿Necesito tarjeta para el plan gratis?
items.answer: No. El paquete gratis son 150 respuestas de por vida por licencia de sitio sin tarjeta.

items.question: ¿Qué pasa cuando se acaban las respuestas gratis?
items.answer: Las nuevas respuestas se pausan hasta que mejores a un paquete de pago. No hay cargos automáticos.

items.question: ¿Están seguros mis datos?
items.answer: Aipify está diseñado para uso empresarial gobernado. Tú controlas las fuentes aprobadas; privacidad y términos están en aipify.ai.

hero.headline: Become an Aipify partner. Help businesses with smarter customer service and internal knowledge.
hero.copy: Do you run a company or a sole proprietorship? Apply to become a Growth Partner, present Buddy Web and Buddy Business to your customers, and earn commission on sales covered by the partner agreement.

keyPoints.text: Present Buddy Web for public website help and Buddy Business for internal company knowledge.

Commission, earning, and payout follow the current partner agreement and approved registrations.

items.question: What is an Aipify Growth Partner?
items.answer: A registered company or sole proprietorship that applies to present Buddy Web and Buddy Business and earn commission on eligible sales under the partner agreement — not a simple affiliate link program.

items.question: Is this an affiliate or referral program?
items.answer: No. Growth Partners operate registered businesses, complete required review/onboarding, and build longer-term customer relationships under partner terms.

items.question: What are the requirements to apply?
items.answer: Provide accurate registration details for a company or sole proprietorship, accept the Growth Partner Terms, and complete review before any selling rights.

items.question: Which products can I present?
items.answer: Primary products are Buddy Web and Buddy Business, with Aipify Core as the shared engine. Do not present planned add-ons as available unless released.

items.question: When can I start selling?
items.answer: Selling rights follow application review and any required onboarding. Until then, you should not represent Aipify as an approved active seller.

items.question: How are commissions handled?
items.answer: Commission, earning, and payout follow the current partner agreement and approved registrations. This page does not publish rates or payout schedules.

items.question: Do I own the customers I bring?
items.answer: Customer accounts are administered on the Aipify Platform. Partners receive attribution and commission according to the partner agreement.

items.question: What support does Aipify provide?
items.answer: Aipify provides product guidance and partner process support through Contact support. Specific portal tools depend on what is enabled after approval.

items.question: Can sole proprietorships (ENK) apply?
items.answer: Yes. Companies and sole proprietorships may apply when they meet registration and partner requirements.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Complete the application on this page. Aipify reviews your submission and confirms next steps.
